description_sq:
Shitet dupleks banimi ne nje nga komplekset me te reja ne zonen e Selites.
Organizohet ne :
- Kati 0 me siperfaqe 70.28 m2 ku gjendet nje ambjent ndenje, nje tualet dhe nje dhome gjumi.
- Kati 1 me siperfaqe 55.2m2 ku gjenden dy dhoma gjumi dhe nje tualet.
Apartament ka nje siperfaqe verande ne katon 0 prej 107 m2.
Disponon poste parkimi me kosto ekstra.
Per me teper informacion na kontaktoni!
description_en: Residential duplex for sale in one of the newest complexes in the Selite area. It is organized in: - Floor 0 with an area of ​​70.28 m2 where there is a living room, a toilet and a bedroom. - 1st floor with an area of ​​55.2m2 where there are two bedrooms and a bathroom. The apartment has a veranda area on the 0th floor of 107 m2. Parking stalls are available at an extra cost. For more information contact us!
